This could bypass any logic/callbacks encapsulated in `Group#remove`, but the diff alone doesn’t prove it’s broken: there’s a new spec exercising `remove_member` that expects the member count to drop to 0, and nothing in the diff shows a required callback/user_count update that `delete(id)` would miss.
